<PAST H1 SPAN 1>This Agreement made and entered into this 10th day of July, 1996 ("Effective Date"), by and between SHARP CORPORATION, a Japanese corporation, having its principal place of business at 22-22, Nagaike-cho, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan (hereinafter called "Sharp") and Hybrid Networks, Inc., an American corporation, having its principal place of business at 10161 Bubb Road, Cupertino, California 95014-4167 (hereinafter called "Hybrid Networks").</PAST H1 SPAN 1>
<PAST H1 SPAN 2>WITNESSETH:</PAST H1 SPAN 2>
<PAST H1 SPAN 3>WHEREAS, Sharp and Hybrid Networks both have as their purpose an interest in exploring a possible business relationship and in order for the parties to explore this relationship, it may be necessary for the parties to disclose certain of their proprietary and other information to each other, which information each of the parties regards as confidential. </PAST H1 SPAN 3><PAST H1 SPAN 4>This confidential information relates to Cable Data Modem.</PAST H1 SPAN 4>
<PAST H1 SPAN 5>NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows:</PAST H1 SPAN 5>
<PAST H1 SPAN 6>1. </PAST H1 SPAN 6><PAST H1 SPAN 7>(a) All of the confidential information (hereinafter "Confidential Information"), including, without limitation, all information relating to business plans, financial or technical matters, trade secrets, designs, know-how, inventions, operations and any other information received or acquired by one party ("Receiving Party") from the other ("Disclosing Party") in the course of exploring the possible business relationship shall be in written form and marked "Confidential," with the name of the Disclosing Party and the date of disclosure. </PAST H1 SPAN 7><PAST H1 SPAN 8>If the Confidential Information is initially disclosed orally, it shall be reduced to written form by the Disclosing Party (including the date of the oral disclosure and name of the Disclosing Party) and presented or mailed to the Receiving Party within fifteen (15) days of the first oral disclosure.</PAST H1 SPAN 8>
<PAST H1 SPAN 9>(b) The Confidential Information shall remain the property of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 9>
<PAST H1 SPAN 10>(c) All information disclosed which is not marked "Confidential," or not reduced to written form and marked "Confidential" if initially disclosed orally shall be considered to be non-confidential and shall not be subject to the obligations imposed by this Agreement. </PAST H1 SPAN 10><PAST H1 SPAN 11>All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be limited to the subject matter mentioned in the Recital. </PAST H1 SPAN 11><PAST H1 SPAN 12>The existence and terms of this Agreement shall be treated as Confidential Information.</PAST H1 SPAN 12>
<PAST H1 SPAN 13>2. The Receiving Party shall:</PAST H1 SPAN 13>
<PAST H1 SPAN 14>(a) hold the Confidential Information in confidence and not disclose it to third parties, except in the limited cases referred to in paragraph "6"; and</PAST H1 SPAN 14>
<PAST H1 SPAN 15>(b) not use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than exploring or examining the possibility of a business relationship between the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 15>
<PAST H1 SPAN 16>3. Either party hereto shall have the right, at any time, to terminate in writing and discussions and exchange of information in connection with the exploration of the possibilities of a business relationship between the parties without any further obligations or liabilities to the other party, other than the obligations of confidentiality hereunder, or any right or obligation relating to the Confidential Information hereunder.</PAST H1 SPAN 16>
<PAST H1 SPAN 17>4.</PAST H1 SPAN 17><PAST H1 SPAN 18>(i) The obligations of the above paragraph "2" shall not apply to any information which:</PAST H1 SPAN 18>
<PAST H1 SPAN 19>(a) is available to the public through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 19>
<PAST H1 SPAN 20>(b) was in the possession of the Receiving Party prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 20>
<PAST H1 SPAN 21>(c) is received independently from a third party who is free to disclose such information to the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 21>
<PAST H1 SPAN 22>(d) is subsequently independently developed by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 22>
<PAST H1 SPAN 23>(e) has been or is made public by the Disclosing Party, such as by commercial use or sale or by publications or patents, or otherwise; or</PAST H1 SPAN 23>
<PAST H1 SPAN 24>(f) is approved for release by written consent of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 24>
<PAST H1 SPAN 25>(ii) Disclosure of Confidential </PAST H1 SPAN 25><PAST H1 SPAN 26>Information shall not be precluded if such disclosure is pursuant to the requirement or request of a governmental agency or by operation of law. </PAST H1 SPAN 26><PAST H1 SPAN 27>Provided, however, the Receiving Party shall promptly give a written notice to the Disclosing party so that the Disclosing Party may seek an appropriate protective order.</PAST H1 SPAN 27>
<PAST H1 SPAN 28>5. All Confidential Information delivered to and/or in the possession of the Receiving Party shall be returned or delivered to the Disclosing Party, with all copies made thereof, in whatever form, if the Disclosing Party so requests.</PAST H1 SPAN 28>
<PAST H1 SPAN 29>6. The Receiving Party agrees that the Confidential Information shall be disclosed to only those people within its respective organizations or its agents, consultants, representatives or advisors who have a need to know the information and who are obligated under terms no less restrictive than those imposed by this Agreement on the Receiving Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 29>
<PAST H1 SPAN 30>7. Each party shall have the right to refuse to accept any information under this Agreement, and nothing herein shall obligate either party to disclose to the other party any particular information. </PAST H1 SPAN 30><PAST H1 SPAN 31>Further, each party acknowledges that no contract or agreement providing for a business relationship, of any nature, shall be deemed to exist unless and until a final definitive agreement has been executed and delivered.</PAST H1 SPAN 31>
<PAST H1 SPAN 32>8. If any official approval is required by a government authority or disclose the Confidential Information hereunder, such disclosure is subject to that approval. </PAST H1 SPAN 32><PAST H1 SPAN 33>Both parties shall comply in all respects with applicable laws, regulations and court orders, including but not limited to laws and regulations on export control, in both parties' countries and other applicable countries.</PAST H1 SPAN 33>
<PAST H1 SPAN 34>9. Disclosure of any information under this Agreement, or otherwise, shall not be construed as granting, directly or by implication, any license under or interest of any kind in any patent, patent application, copyright or other intellectual property rights.</PAST H1 SPAN 34>
<PAST H1 SPAN 35>10. The Disclosing Party represents and warrants that it has the right to disclose the information disclosed under the terms of this Agreement and that disclosure of this information does not conflict with the terms of any agreement between the Disclosing Party and a third party.</PAST H1 SPAN 35>
<PAST H1 SPAN 36>11. The parties hereto shall not be obligated to compensate each other for the disclosure and/or use pursuant to the terms of this Agreement of any information exchanged in connection with this Agreement or the discussions between the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 36>
<PAST H1 SPAN 37>12. This Agreement supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, representations and statements, whether oral or written, between the parties relating to the disclosure of the Confidential Information. </PAST H1 SPAN 37><PAST H1 SPAN 38>The terms of this Agreement may not be changed except by subsequent written agreement duly signed by an officer of each of the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 38>
<PAST H1 SPAN 39>13. Subject to Paragraph </PAST H1 SPAN 39><PAST H1 SPAN 40>"4" hereof, the obligation of the Receiving Party provided in Paragraph "2" hereof shall continue for three (3) years from the date of each receipt of the Confidential Information, even after termination of this Agreement according to paragraph "3" hereof.</PAST H1 SPAN 40>
<PAST H1 SPAN 41>14. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Japan.</PAST H1 SPAN 41>
<PAST H1 SPAN 42>15. The Receiving Party acknowledges that remedies of damages may be inadequate to protect against breach of this Agreement and the Receiving Party agrees in advance to the granting of injunctive or other equitable relief to the Disclosing Party in addition to any other remedy which may be available to the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 42>

The Disclosing Party does not make any representation or warranty, except as may be specifically provided in writing, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, or as to its utility or suitability for any purpose of the Receiving Party and the Disclosing Party expressly disclaims any right of the Receiving Party to rely thereon, or any liability to the Receiving Party resulting from the use of the Confidential Information.</PAST H1 SPAN 43>
<PAST H1 SPAN 44>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties by their duly authorized representatives have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date first set forth above.</PAST H1 SPAN 44>
